info.title: Monetra API
info.description: REST API for PROJECT MONETRA. Authenticate with a Bearer access token from /auth/login. Monetary amounts are decimal strings (never floats). Refresh tokens live in an httpOnly cookie; /auth/refresh and /auth/logout also require the X-CSRF-Token header obtained from /auth/csrf.
